sentences.en: The first space stations rotated axially to produce artificial gravity.
sentences.zh: 早期的空间站通过轴向旋转来产生人造重力。

sentences.en: The earth wobbles slightly as it rotates around its axis.
sentences.zh: 地球在自转时会轻微地晃动。

sentences.en: In flight, the airplane rotates about the center of gravity.
sentences.zh: 飞行中，飞机以重心为轴进行旋转。
